artifacts.summary: Three sequential phases (3.5h) turning the compiled research prototype into the E3 device-selection probe: transcribe the comparison core, bridge it to the real box-dot(Fp) formula on the Bool fixture, then write the scoped selection header (time-axis Ramsey (d) via in-tree infinite_ramsey_pairs framed by the HWZ/GKWZ MSO route (c); (a)/(b) not selected; no complexity bound) and wire scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh.

memory_candidates.content: Planning pattern for evidence probes whose specified test shapes turn out to be inert: when research proves the named shapes cannot discriminate the candidates (here box-dot(Fp)/box-dot(Pp) are co-safety, decided by reachability/pigeonhole on any finite fixture), do not drop the shapes and do not substitute a different experiment. Plan the probe to (1) run the specified shapes and record inertness as the mechanized result, (2) add a falsifier showing where the candidates stop coinciding (here an infinite acyclic fibre refuting pigeonhole-tier lasso sufficiency), and (3) make the selection on the evidence that remains (infrastructure present in tree/Mathlib, literature covering the exact target), with the header stating explicitly that the selection is not a behavioural discrimination. Keep the deliverable to transcription of already-compiled research lemmas plus one definitional bridge to the real formula; new mathematics belongs to the substrate task the probe gates.
